question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. **
Impervious**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Permeable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **Impervious** means not allowing fluid or other substances to pass through; impenetrable or unaffected by external influences. (अभेद्य)
 
 
• **Example:** The jacket is made of impervious material, ensuring that no water can seep through.
 
 
• **Permeable** refers to something that allows liquids or gases to pass through it; the opposite of impervious. (भेद्य)
 
 
• **Example:** This fabric is permeable, allowing air and moisture to flow freely.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **"Impervious"** is **"Permeable."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Permeable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Impregnable** (अभेद्य): Unable to be defeated or penetrated; very strong or secure. 
 
 
• **Example:** The fortress was impregnable due to its solid construction.
 
 
 
• **Durable** (टिकाऊ): Able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage; long-lasting. 
 
 
• **Example:** The furniture was made of durable wood, ensuring it would last for years.
 
 
 
• **Impassive** (भावहीन): Not showing emotion or being unaffected by external factors. 
 
 
• **Example:** He remained impassive even after hearing the shocking news.
 
 

47:T967,
 
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.
